about.title: A sauna for a crowd
about.lede: With 100½" of bench and the door moved to the side, the 582 is built for long sessions with friends.
items: Two tiers, 34" and 17" high, run the full 100½" width, so five people can sit or one can lie down.
Three 33½" panels face your yard. The 25¾" glass door sits on a side wall, so you can place it to suit your path from the house.
Western red cedar inside and out, in rustic knotty or smooth clear grade, with clear cedar benches.
An EPDM roof, tempered glass and raised base skids keep it dry and heating well all year.
